verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs say FirebaseUI, its first-party drop-in auth UI, is open source, and the firebase-tools CLI source is published on GitHub. That counts as open source for client-side pieces of the product only. Nothing shows the core hosted services (Firestore, Auth backend, Functions runtime) are readable under an open license. Missing for 10: open-licensed source for the core backend services, a named license (e.g. Apache/MIT) for the CLI or SDKs, and independent confirmation of source availability.
